title: Best local model for a game narrator (12-16 GB VRAM, tool calling, no reasoning)?
author: Neraventh
selftext:
I'm building a small open-source tabletop RPG game for my PC. A rules engine handles all dice and combat. The LLM is only the narrator: it describes the scene, voices the characters and calls tools.

 What I need:   
\- fits in 12-16 GB of VRAM (the game itself uses less than 1 GB)   
\- reliable tool calling through an OpenAI-compatible API (LM Studio / Ollama)   
\- answers without a long thinking phase: the text is read aloud, so the first sentence must come in 2-3 seconds   
\- good narrative prose, in English (and Italian)   
\- about 32k context 

So far: gemma-4-12b works but makes mistakes, qwen3.8-27b writes well but is too slow for voice, gpt-oss-20b writes very short turns. 

What would you try? Any settings or prompt tricks for small models?

Thank you in advance for any hint you can give me!
